rationale: The 8.7 Cloud matrix groups Guided Response enhancements in Premier. The 8.6 task guide and current 8.8 aggregate describe the base workflow in both Cloud editions with Platform 10.2+, ES 8.6+ and paired SOAR. The 8.6 task also qualifies the model and connector permissions. An enhancement heading does not establish base entitlement or exact enhancement access.

audiences: Readers comparing documented ES deployment and edition scope
exclusions: The reviewed scope does not establish unlisted compatibility, customer enablement, entitlement or authorization.
